name: Frankenstein
title: Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus
author: Mary Shelley
description: A young scientist, Victor Frankenstein, brings a creature to life and then abandons it. The novel explores ambition, responsibility, and what it means to be human, and is often called the first science fiction novel.

name: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
description: Alice follows a white rabbit down a rabbit hole and finds a strange world of talking animals, playing cards, and nonsense logic. It is one of the best known works of children's literature.

name: Dracula
title: Dracula
author: Bram Stoker
description: Told through letters and diary entries, Dracula follows a group of friends who fight the vampire Count Dracula as he moves from Transylvania to England. It shaped the modern vampire story.

name: Moby-Dick
title: Moby-Dick; or, The Whale
author: Herman Melville
description: Captain Ahab leads the whaling ship Pequod on an obsessive hunt for the white whale that took his leg. Narrated by Ishmael, it is a story of revenge, fate, and the sea.

name: Pride and Prejudice
title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: Elizabeth Bennet and the proud Mr. Darcy misjudge each other before they learn to see past first impressions. A witty look at class, marriage, and manners in Regency England.
